mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT(PROD_ENDDATE, PROD_CATEGORY, PROD_WRITER, PROD_NAME, PROD_PRICE, PROD_COUNT, PROD_DISCOUNT, PROD_PURCHASE_YN, PROD_CONTENT, PROD_COMMENT) VALUES ( #{prodEnddate},#{prodCategory}, #{prodWriter},#{prodName},#{prodPrice},#{prodCount},#{prodDiscount},#{prodPurchaseYn},#{prodContent},#{prodComment})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CONCAT(A1.group_ID, A1.CATEGORY_ID) AS CATEGORY_KEY, ##카테고리 키 (그룹 + 키 형태로 카테고리분류) CASE A1.category_parent_LV WHEN 0 THEN A1.category_detail_NM WHEN 1 THEN CONCAT(A2.category_detail_NM,' > ', A1.category_detail_NM) WHEN 2 THEN CONCAT(A3.category_detail_NM, ' > ', A2.category_detail_NM,' > ', A1.category_detail_NM) END as CATEGORY_NAV FROM PRODUCT_CATEGORY A1 LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT_CATEGORY A2 ON A1.CATEGORY_PARENT_LV = A2.CATEGORY_LV AND A1.CATEGORY_DETAIL_PARENT_LV = A2.CATEGORY_DETAIL_LV AND A1.GROUP_ID = A2.GROUP_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT_CATEGORY A3 ON A2.CATEGORY_PARENT_LV = A3.CATEGORY_LV AND A2.CATEGORY_DETAIL_PARENT_LV = A3.CATEGORY_DETAIL_LV ORDER BY CATEGORY_NAV ASC) C ON P.PROD_CATEGORY = C.CATEGORY_KEY WHERE PROD_WRITER = #{prodWriter} ORDER BY PROD_ID DESC LIMIT #{cri.pageStart}, #{cri.amount}
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET PROD_ENDDATE = #{prodEnddate}, PROD_NAME = #{prodName}, PROD_PRICE = #{prodPrice}, PROD_COUNT = #{prodCount}, PROD_DISCOUNT = #{prodDiscount}, PROD_PURCHASE_YN = #{prodPurchaseYn}, PROD_CONTENT = #{prodContent}, PROD_COMMENT = #{prodComment} WHERE PROD_ID = #{prodId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM DEMO_ORDER O LEFT JOIN DEMO_MEMBER M ON O.MID = M.MID
select * from demo_member as m left join demo_order as o on o.mid = m.mid where m.mid = 1
